item.title: Greenland Panics As Marco Rubio Seen Donning Parka
item.description: NUUK — Greenland has descended into panic after U.S. Secretary of State was photographed donning a heavy parka.

item.title: Game Of Candy Land Testing Dad's Commitment To Dry January
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, AR — Local dad Matt Carver has found his commitment to doing "Dry January" severely tested by a game of Candy Land with his three-year-old daughter Kaitlyn.

item.title: White House Announces Over 1,000,000 New Jobs Were Created In December But They Were All Filled By Marco Rubio
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — The White House announced that job creation in December blew past expectations, with over one million new jobs being created in just one month. However, the unemployment rate remained unchanged, as every single one of the jobs was filled by Marco Rubio.

item.title: Maduro Now Polling As Most Popular Democrat
item.description: U.S. — The 2028 presidential race took a surprising turn this week following the events that took place in Venezuela, as the latest round of polling showed that deposed dictator Nicolas Maduro had taken the early primary lead as the most popular Democrat.

item.title: Family Stages Intervention Over 40-Year-Old Dad's Skinny Jeans
item.description: DANSVILLE, NY — The Rodgers family reportedly recruited a social worker to help moderate what turned out to be an emotional intervention for Steve Rodgers, a 40-year-old man who has persisted in wearing skinny jeans.

item.title: Democrats Once Again Threaten Civil War To Stop Republicans From Taking Away Their Slave Laborers
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS, MN — For the second time in American history, Democrats are threatening civil war if Republicans do not stop taking away their slave laborers.
